stage: P2-RJ-E: sample-size expansion of the single frozen P2-RJ leverage statistic Q50 (final diagnostic stage; not method development)

population.rule: ALL structurally valid EN-confusion positions of the 300-utterance D-dev-select R2/P2 panel under the unchanged P2-R eligibility code (experiments/inference_cf_p2r_population.build, candidates before selection); no cap, no selection, no position dropped for any outcome-related reason
population.include_original: the 60 P2-RJ EN-confusion positions are a subset and are recomputed in this run; every eligible position enters the estimator exactly once
population.eligibility_identity_check: rebuilding with the frozen P2-R config must reproduce the frozen P2-R population hash

competitor.rule: c* = the first token of torch.topk(log_softmax(processed unedited logits), 20) that is not in Y_ref (the exact P2-R summarize ordering on which the frozen P2-RJ c* was defined)
competitor.original_positions: the frozen P2-RJ c* is used and must equal the rule's value (otherwise the position is a state mismatch)
competitor.new_positions: computed by a no-grad pre-pass on the identical unedited B branch before any gradient

reused_unchanged_from_p2rj: dialogue bootstrap (10000, seed 240924, mean of dialogue means, percentile)
Bonferroni alpha 0.05/2 per bound (P2-RJ decision-family multiplicity)

analysis.primary: Q50 = dialogue-weighted fraction of valid EN-confusion positions with rho = |g_tan| e* / gap >= 0.5

diagnosis.P2_RJ_E_DIRECTION_ISSUE: valid and SUBSTANTIAL (bf16 and fp32 agree)
diagnosis.P2_RJ_E_DIRECTION_AND_SITE_ISSUE: valid and WEAK (bf16 and fp32 agree)
diagnosis.P2_RJ_E_DIRECTION_CONFIRMED_SITE_UNRESOL: valid and (UNRESOLVED, or bf16/fp32 leverage classes differ, or precision cosine < 0.9) -- terminal

validity.V1: manifest, config, positions, source hashes, Git commit
validity.V2: every utterance row ok in both passes; all positions present
validity.V3: per position: decode-rule argmax == baseline token; grad-step logits bitwise equal to the unedited step; probe site == recorder site; recomputed best non-reference token == c* or exact tie; margin via the gradient path == margin via the summary path (|diff| <= 1e-3). Original positions additionally: P2-RJ/P2-R identity checks (P2-RJ state_checks) and overlap reproduction vs P2-RJ run1 bf16 (A, |g_tan|, gap within 1e-6 relative; margin gradient vector cosine >= 0.9999). More than 5% of positions mismatching = run invalid
validity.V6: first-order validity is carried over from P2-RJ (pooled r = 0.918 at the same site/energy/protocol); no new perturbation is run
validity.V7: fp32 replicate: median cos(g_tan bf16, g_tan fp32) >= 0.9 and identical leverage class; failure maps to SITE_UNRESOLVED (terminal), not to a rerun
validity.invalid_run: a V1-V5 failure is an implementation/infrastructure invalidity: no diagnosis; at most a versioned rerun with the failed attempt preserved

descriptive: kappa(+d), kappa(-d), kappa(random), cos(g_tan, +d) (H1 descriptive confirmation only)

terminal: P2-RJ-E ends the diagnostic program whatever the outcome: no P2-RJ-F, no further Q50 expansion, no new Jacobian, random-control or localization diagnostic.
